# OSSEC HIDS

OSSEC HIDS is a GPLv2 host-based intrusion detection system. It provides file integrity monitoring (FIM), log analysis, rootkit detection, and active response.

- Project: https://github.com/ossec/ossec-hids
- Website: https://www.ossec.net
- Documentation: https://www.ossec.net/docs/
- License: GNU General Public License version 2 (LICENSE)
- Changelog: CHANGELOG.md
- Current stable version: 4.3.0 (git tag 4.3.0)
- Previous stable version: 4.2.0
- Source tarball: https://github.com/ossec/ossec-hids/archive/refs/tags/4.3.0.tar.gz
- Floating latest tag (stable only): https://github.com/ossec/ossec-hids/archive/latest.tar.gz
- Maintenance branch for 4.3.x backports: v4.3.0
- Development branch: main
